newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Georg Fischer jumps on recommendations.
newsitem.headline: Georg Fischer jumps on recommendations.

text.p: Shares of Swiss industrial group Georg Fischer AG rose sharply in an otherwise quiet market as two new buy recommendations from banks sparked an advance, dealers said.
At 1150 GMT, bearer shares were up 38 francs to 1,299 and registered stock rose nine to 245.

Signs of economic recovery in Germany, which is a focus of Fischer business, and the weaker Swiss franc should help the company, dealers said. One said the shares, which have lagged the market, were "rediscovered" because they had room to rise.
